entries.finding: Cron ticks had to parse liveness.json + paper_state.json + tail of bot.log (regex on LiveIndia/Heartbeat/SCAN lines) to answer 'what is the market + bot doing right now'. No consolidated snapshot existed; also data_cache/mavis_self_evolve.json was missing entirely even though this cron was supposed to append to it.
entries.action_taken: Added scripts/market_snapshot.py (~150 lines) that consolidates liveness + paper_state + last LiveIndia/Heartbeat/SCAN lines from bot.log into a single data_cache/market_snapshot.json. Exits 0 on fresh market data, 2 if stale. Future cron ticks, watchdogs, and dashboards can now read one file for current state instead of three. Created mavis_self_evolve.json (this file) since it was missing.

entries.finding: mavis_monitor.py logs 'yfinance fetch failed: single positional indexer is out-of-bounds' ~60 times per 24h (counted in logs/mavis_monitor.log). Root cause: yfinance returns empty DataFrames when the market is closed; the old code did `history(period='1d')['Close'].iloc[-1]` which raises on empty. Worse, the existing comment promised 'Skip market-closed heavy checks at night (still run health check)' but the code still hit yfinance every 60s overnight — comment and behavior were out of sync.
entries.action_taken: Split _fetch_spot into _safe_yf_close (silent on empty DataFrame, logs only on real error) and added _is_market_hours helper (Mon-Fri 08:30-15:45 IST). The main loop now gates the yfinance call on _is_market_hours; during off-hours it returns (0,0,0) without hitting the network, so the 60 nightly warnings disappear and the 1440 calls/day drop to ~390. Health checks (bot liveness, dashboards, log staleness) still run 24/7 as before. Tested all time/weekday edge cases — verified Sat/Sun/early-morning all correctly skip.

entries.finding: supervisor_loop.ps1 (PID 17944) was spinning every 5s trying to launch `kotak_supervisor.py`, which had been moved to `_archive\legacy_orchestrators\kotak_supervisor.py`. Each cycle produced 2 log lines and 1 stderr line ('No such file or directory'); over time logs/supervisor_loop.log grew to 18.1MB / 227,565 lines of pure dead noise (~3MB/day). Root cause: the bot lifecycle is now managed by NSSM services (KotakBotPaper / KotakDashboard, both Running) plus watchdog.ps1 for restart-on-crash — kotak_supervisor.py is no longer the active orchestrator. The vbs wrapper (`supervisor_wrapper.vbs`) still re-launches supervisor_loop.ps1 on user logon, but the script itself never noticed the target file was missing.
entries.action_taken: Added Test-SupervisorScriptPresent() to supervisor_loop.ps1 and a new branch in the main loop: when kotak_supervisor.py is not at the project root, log ONCE with context (which services actually manage the bot) and Start-Sleep 3600s before re-check. Wrapper stays alive in case the file is restored later, but the 5-second spin is dead. Killed the noisy old process (PID 17944) and started a new powershell host running the fixed script (PID 19064) so the noise stops immediately, not on next reboot. Confirmed: new log entry at 12:04:09 says 'kotak_supervisor.py not found ... Sleeping 3600 s before re-check'; next entry will be ~13:04 IST. From now on, supervisor_loop.log grows by ~2 lines/hour instead of ~1700. AGENTS.md needs a future note: the supervisor_loop.ps1 is now a no-op (intentionally); use NSSM + watchdog.ps1 to manage the bot.
entries.file_or_cron_changed: supervisor_loop.ps1 (modified, +27/-0), logs/supervisor_loop.log (noise eliminated), data_cache/mavis_self_evolve.json (this entry). Commit: 924cf4e.
